import html from typing import List # A simple template for the forum post. Placeholders are named for clarity. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title_key}

Author: {username_key}

{body_key}
{tag_elements}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str Identifier of the post's creator. title_key : str The heading/title of the user's post. body_key : str The main content/body of the post. tag_elements : List[str] Sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS-protected HTML string for the forum post. """ # Escape all user-supplied text to prevent XSS escaped_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(body_key) # Wrap each tag in a and escape the tag text escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tag_elements ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Render the final HTML using the predefined template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username_key=escaped_username, title_key=escaped_title, body_key=escaped_body, tag_elements=tags_html )
